name: Akaigawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Akaigawa village emblem in red and green: a red ring enclosing a green stylised character of stacked strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Akaigawa, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 June 1968.

features.role: Akaigawa village emblem — a red ring enclosing a green stylised character of stacked strokes
